criterionVerdicts.reasoning: Observed, not merely absent: the product stopped serving. naive-user-1's steps.jsonl shows the app answering normally for steps 1-9 (home page, Adopt form, /projects at 00:39:11) and then every request from step 10 (00:39:30) onward returning net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED for the remaining 26 steps (personas/naive-user-1/shots/11-goto-failed.png). The other four personas — naive-user-2 (36 attempts, ~15 min), naive-user-3 (17 attempts), returning-user (27 attempts), spec-auditor (24 attempts) — never got a single page to load, each recording only the browser connection-error page. A user cannot accomplish the journey unassisted when the process dies mid-session and does not come back.

Partial: naive-user-1's personas/naive-user-1/shots/05-click.png does show the home page carrying an 'Adopt a repo' toggle, a path textbox, and an Adopt button with the caption 'A run will infer the boot recipe and propose journeys — you confirm them on one sheet.' But no repository was ever brought in. The only path ever submitted (steps 3-8 of personas/naive-user-1/steps.jsonl) was a non-git sandbox folder, which was rejected; /Users/alexraymond/ligma-classic was never entered anywhere, and the process died before a second attempt. spec-auditor recorded crit_1 as not-tested. An affordance being visible is not the promised result.

No persona ever reached a boot-recipe confirmation. The home-page caption in personas/naive-user-1/shots/05-click.png promises the run will 'infer the boot recipe', but no run ever started, so nothing was confirmed once or otherwise. spec-auditor recorded crit_2 as not-tested against personas/spec-auditor/shots/02-goto-failed.png.

No exploration or journey proposal was ever observed. naive-user-1's last successful step was a skeleton-loading /projects page (personas/naive-user-1/shots/07-goto.png) with no adopted project on it; every subsequent step failed on connection refused. spec-auditor: not-tested.

The review-before-write sheet was never reached by any persona. spec-auditor recorded crit_4 as not-tested (personas/spec-auditor/shots/04-goto-failed.png); no other persona's steps.jsonl contains a step past the home page and /projects.

No project's Verify surface was ever opened — no project was created. spec-auditor recorded crit_5 as not-tested against personas/spec-auditor/shots/05-goto-failed.png; returning-user, who would have corroborated with existing data, never loaded a page at all (27 consecutive connection refusals).

No Knowledge surface was ever reached. spec-auditor recorded crit_6 as not-tested (personas/spec-auditor/shots/06-goto-failed.png), and no other persona's steps.jsonl shows a successful navigation to any project-scoped page.

Nothing was recorded about any repo's behaviour, so where it is kept could not be checked. The only related signal is a wording claim: naive-user-1 reported a validation message saying a folder 'is not a git repository — an ephemeral env is cut from a git worktree', citing personas/naive-user-1/shots/06-click.png — but I opened that screenshot and it shows the unchanged Adopt form with no toast or error text visible, so the claim has no screenshot behind it. Even if shown, a hint about worktrees is not evidence that behaviour records are kept centrally rather than committed into the adopted repo. spec-auditor: not-tested.

humanDecisions.question: Is the process death a product defect or a harness/environment problem — and should the run be repeated before this verdict is treated as a judgement on the feature?
humanDecisions.context: The server answered nine steps for naive-user-1 (last success 00:39:11 on /projects) and was refusing connections 19 seconds later, staying down for the remaining ~10 minutes and for all four other personas who started later. The crash immediately follows an Adopt POST with a non-git path plus a /projects visit, which is a plausible crash trigger worth reproducing, but nothing in the evidence proves causation. Every criterion below crit_goal is unknown purely because of this.

humanDecisions.question: Adopt with an invalid path shows no visible error on first submit — acceptable, or a fix before this journey ships?
humanDecisions.context: naive-user-1 clicked Adopt at 00:38:02 and the screenshot two seconds later (personas/naive-user-1/shots/05-click.png) shows the form completely unchanged — same spinner-state button, no message. The second click's screenshot (06-click.png) is likewise unchanged. The persona reports an HTTP 400 was returned both times. A first-time user gets no feedback that anything happened.

humanDecisions.question: The pre-crash instability signals on a page that did load — worth investigating separately?
humanDecisions.context: personas/naive-user-1/shots/01-goto.png shows the home page stuck in skeleton placeholders with the sidebar reading 'Governor offline', and 07-goto.png shows /projects in the same skeleton state; the persona also logged an HTTP 405 from /api/dashboard and a React hydration-mismatch error. The page rendered but never populated.

humanDecisions.question: Evidence bookkeeping: run.json lists five persona reports but names personas/naive-user-1/report.json three times.
humanDecisions.context: run.json personaReports omits naive-user-2 and naive-user-3 entirely (their directories exist on disk with full steps/transcripts). The run also still shows status 'running' with finishedAt null. This does not change any verdict — I read the persona directories directly — but the manifest is wrong and would mislead anything that consumes it.
